title: Perceptions of AI Bad Behavior: Variations on Discordant Non-Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews assessing non-experts' perceptions of AI bad behavior, where participants reported general distrust due to observed racial bias in tech.
Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews where participants identified AI bad behavior as non-responses or limitations based on political constraints and predisposed leanings.
Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews where participants characterized AI bad behavior as generating responses with insensitivity around religion.
Qualitative thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews where participants highlighted AI constraints and non-responses based on cultural limitations.
